name: Zanaris (south of the bank, flower pond)
accessNote: Six Otherworldly beings (level 64) roam south of the bank in Zanaris, by the flower pond. Requires Lost City for access (fairy ring / Lost City route). Can be safespotted across or by corner-trapping on the pond corners, though they wander a lot; five of the six have a wander radius that permits safespotting from right next to the pond.
